what: PlanarMap representation, agreed with the user 2026-10-20 (Plan 1b brainstorming): vertices and edges are integer handles, and only the PlanarMap holds their state. Every operation returns the new map, plus the created handle where useful (e.g. {map, vertex_id} = insert_vertex(map, point)). Callers thread the map through Enum.reduce rather than holding live references as Taprats' Star.buildUnit does.
why: Taprats mutates Map, Edge and Vertex in place (splitEdgesByVertex touches five objects per call), so value snapshots held by callers would go stale.
